nodes.label: data.js
nodes.description: Core data layer module: localStorage persistence, GitHub Gist sync, employee CRUD, time tracking, PIN auth, export/import

nodes.label: DB_KEY (restaurant_v1)
nodes.description: localStorage key for main restaurant data: employees, pointages, PIN hash, archives

nodes.label: SYNC_KEY (restaurant_sync)
nodes.description: localStorage key for GitHub Gist sync configuration (token, gistId, lastSync)

nodes.label: load()
nodes.description: Reads and JSON-parses the main data object from localStorage using DB_KEY; returns default structure if empty

nodes.label: save(data)
nodes.description: Serializes data to localStorage and debounces a 4-second timer to call syncToGist

nodes.label: _syncTimer
nodes.description: Debounce timer handle used to delay Gist sync 4 seconds after the last save call

nodes.label: getSyncConfig()
nodes.description: Reads and parses the GitHub Gist sync config (token, gistId, lastSync) from localStorage

nodes.label: setSyncConfig(cfg)
nodes.description: Serializes and stores the sync config object into localStorage under SYNC_KEY

nodes.label: syncToGist(data)
nodes.description: Async: POSTs or PATCHes restaurant data to a GitHub Gist using token from sync config; creates gist if none exists; updates lastSync timestamp and sync badge

nodes.label: restoreFromGist()
nodes.description: Async: fetches restaurant-backup.json content from GitHub Gist and writes it to localStorage; returns true on success

nodes.label: setupSync(token)
nodes.description: Validates GitHub token against /user endpoint, persists sync config, and triggers initial syncToGist

nodes.label: updateSyncBadge(ok)
nodes.description: Updates the #sync-badge DOM element with cloud sync status icon and last-sync time

nodes.label: hashPin(pin)
nodes.description: Async: SHA-256 hashes a numeric PIN string using Web Crypto API; returns hex string

nodes.label: minutesDiff(debut, fin)
nodes.description: Calculates minute difference between two HH:MM time strings

nodes.label: formatDuration(mins)
nodes.description: Converts total minutes to human-readable Xh00 string

nodes.label: today()
nodes.description: Returns current date as YYYY-MM-DD ISO string

nodes.label: currentMonth()
nodes.description: Returns current year-month as YYYY-MM string

nodes.label: formatDate(iso)
nodes.description: Converts YYYY-MM-DD to DD/MM/YYYY display format

nodes.label: getEmployes()
nodes.description: Returns active employees sorted alphabetically by name

nodes.label: addEmploye(nom)
nodes.description: Creates a new employee with timestamp ID, adds to data, and saves

nodes.label: renameEmploye(id, nom)
nodes.description: Finds employee by ID and updates their name, then saves

nodes.label: deleteEmploye(id)
nodes.description: Removes employee and all their pointage records by ID, then saves

nodes.label: getPointages(employeId, date)
nodes.description: Returns all service records (midi/soir) for an employee on a specific date

nodes.label: savePointage(employeId, date, service, heureDebut, heureFin, repasPris)
nodes.description: Writes a single service time entry (midi or soir) for an employee on a date; calls save()
nodes.norm_label: savepointage(employeid, date, service, heuredebut, heurefin, repaspris)

nodes.label: calcRecap(mois)
nodes.description: Aggregates total hours and meal counts per active employee for a given month

nodes.label: verifyPin(pin)
nodes.description: Async: hashes input PIN and compares to stored hash; returns boolean

nodes.label: changePin(ancienPin, nouveauPin)
nodes.description: Validates old PIN, enforces 6-digit rule on new PIN, updates stored PIN hash

nodes.label: cloturerMois(mois)
nodes.description: Archives monthly recap data and deletes pointage entries for the closed month

nodes.label: exportData()
nodes.description: Creates a downloadable JSON blob of the full data store with today's date in filename

nodes.label: importData(file)
nodes.description: Reads a JSON file via FileReader and writes its content into localStorage

nodes.label: Data Schema
nodes.description: Root data object: { employes: [], pointages: {}, pin: <sha256-hex>, archives: [] }

nodes.label: GitHub Gist API
nodes.description: External REST API used for cloud backup; endpoints: GET/PATCH /gists/:id, POST /gists, GET /user

nodes.label: localStorage
nodes.description: Browser storage used as primary database for employee, pointage, PIN, and sync config data

nodes.label: Web Crypto API
nodes.description: Browser crypto.subtle.digest used for SHA-256 PIN hashing

nodes.label: index.html
nodes.description: Main PWA shell: all UI sections, navigation logic, and inline JavaScript application controller

nodes.label: Section: Home
nodes.description: Landing page with two cards: enter hours (employees) and manager area (PIN); also link to change PIN

nodes.label: Section: Employes
nodes.description: Employee list for time entry selection; includes add employee input field

nodes.label: Section: Saisie (Time Entry)
nodes.description: Time entry form for midi and soir services per employee per day; date navigation arrows

nodes.label: Section: PIN
nodes.description: Password input screen for manager authentication with 6-digit numeric PIN

nodes.label: Section: Dashboard Responsable
nodes.description: Manager dashboard: monthly recap table, export, print, change code, close month actions

nodes.label: Section: Employee Detail
nodes.description: Per-employee detail view showing daily breakdown of hours and meals for current month

nodes.label: Section: Change PIN
nodes.description: Form to change manager PIN code requiring old and new code fields

nodes.label: Section: Sync / Backup
nodes.description: Settings panel with accordion sections for auto (GitHub Gist) and manual (file) backup

nodes.label: Modal: Employee Deletion
nodes.description: Confirmation modal requiring user to type employee name before deletion

nodes.label: #sync-badge
nodes.description: Header UI element showing cloud sync status (last sync time or error icon)

nodes.label: showSection(id)
nodes.description: Navigation controller: hides all sections, activates target section, calls section-specific render functions

nodes.label: renderEmployes()
nodes.description: Renders employee list with Saisir and delete buttons

nodes.label: supprimerEmploye(id, nom)
nodes.description: Opens deletion confirmation modal with employee name

nodes.label: fermerModal()
nodes.description: Closes employee deletion modal and clears pending deletion state

nodes.label: confirmerSuppression()
nodes.description: Validates typed name matches employee name, then calls deleteEmploye and refreshes list

nodes.label: ajouterEmploye()
nodes.description: Reads new employee name input and calls addEmploye then re-renders list

nodes.label: selectionnerEmploye(id, nom)
nodes.description: Sets currentEmployeId/Nom state and navigates to saisie section

nodes.label: renderSaisie()
nodes.description: Populates time entry form with existing pointage data or defaults for current employee and date

nodes.label: changerJour(delta)
nodes.description: Advances or rewinds currentDate by delta days and re-renders saisie

nodes.label: sauvegarder()
nodes.description: Validates time entries for midi/soir, calls savePointage for each service, shows confirmation

nodes.label: validerPin()
nodes.description: Reads PIN input, calls verifyPin; navigates to responsable section on success

nodes.label: renderRecap()
nodes.description: Renders monthly summary table using calcRecap data; shows employee hours and meals

nodes.label: changerMois(delta)
nodes.description: Adjusts currentMois by delta months and re-renders recap

nodes.label: voirDetail(id, nom)
nodes.description: Renders per-day detail for an employee and navigates to section-detail

nodes.label: cloturerMoisAction()
nodes.description: Confirms with user then calls cloturerMois, rolls currentMois back to previous month

nodes.label: changerCode()
nodes.description: Reads old and new PIN fields, calls changePin; shows success or error alert

nodes.label: exportTableau()
nodes.description: Generates styled HTML report of monthly recap, opens in new tab as Blob URL

nodes.label: toggleAccordion(id)
nodes.description: Toggles open/closed CSS class on accordion body and updates icon

nodes.label: renderSyncStatus()
nodes.description: Displays current sync config status (active with last sync time or unconfigured)

nodes.label: activerSync()
nodes.description: Reads GitHub token input, calls setupSync; updates UI on success or shows error

nodes.label: restaurerDepuisGist()
nodes.description: Calls restoreFromGist and shows result alert in sync section

nodes.label: importerFichier(input)
nodes.description: Handles file input change event, calls importData with selected file

nodes.label: App State Variables
nodes.description: currentEmployeId, currentEmployeNom, currentDate, currentMois — navigation and selection state

nodes.label: DEFAULTS (Service Times)
nodes.description: Default time slots: midi 11:00-15:00, soir 19:00-23:00

nodes.label: sw.js (Service Worker)
nodes.description: Service worker providing offline caching for all PWA assets; cache-first fetch strategy

nodes.label: CACHE (pointage-v5)
nodes.description: Cache storage name; version bump clears old caches on activate

nodes.label: SW install event
nodes.description: Opens cache and adds all FILES; calls skipWaiting to activate immediately

nodes.label: SW activate event
nodes.description: Deletes all old caches that don't match current CACHE name; claims clients

nodes.label: SW fetch event
nodes.description: Cache-first strategy: returns cached response or falls back to network fetch

nodes.label: manifest.json (PWA Manifest)
nodes.description: Web App Manifest: name=Pointage Restaurant, standalone display, dark theme #1a1a2e, SVG icon

nodes.label: icon.svg
nodes.description: PWA app icon: 100x100 rounded rectangle with dark background (#1a1a2e) and restaurant emoji

nodes.label: Restaurant PWA App
nodes.description: Installable Progressive Web App for restaurant employee time tracking with offline support
